title: A Strength-Based Employment Maintenance Program for Individuals on the Autism Spectrum
official: A Strength-Based Employment Maintenance Program for Individuals on the Autism Spectrum
summary: The investigators are looking to evaluate how effective a training program that focuses on character strengths may be in improving job maintenance skills in young adults. The investigators are examining the effects of this intervention in young adults who feel they would like to help in improving their satisfaction with work, and in keeping their jobs.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Lives in the United States of America
* Between the ages of 14-26
* Speaks English well and at a 4th grade reading level

Exclusion Criteria:

* Had a stroke, Traumatic Brain Injury, or neurological injury or disease in the past(like brain tumor or epilepsy)
* Has a history of significant psychiatric illness(like schizophrenia or psychosis)
* Has uncontrolled seizures or other unstable medical complications
